verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at lowenstein.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Its content is agent-oriented: a firm overview, practice summaries for Venture Capital Investments and Venture M&A, deal volume, and office locations. An agent can be pointed at it to learn the firm's offerings. Missing for 10: evidence of llms-full.txt or markdown page variants, a view of how completely the file covers all practice areas, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use beyond the probe.
